sourceVisualNotes: Actual top row is a matched copper/silver/gold small pointed crown family, bottom row is low queen diadem, red bow with crystal cross centerpiece, and a blue central upright/sideways bar surrounded by broad white-blue feathers. Treat source2984 as crane-feather blessing ornament from description, not assume its equipped silhouette or animation.

items.name: bronze-flower-award-crown
items.designBrief: A compact open CROWN with rounded copper/bronze flower-shaped lower band, five short pointed uprights tipped in red-orange stones, taller slim center finial. Warm COPPER is the dominant metal, modest jade cloud carving, no head, no text or prize numeral.

items.name: silver-flower-award-crown
items.designBrief: Matched crown family but dominant pearl SILVER/ivory metal, five clear-crystal upright points and tall central silver finial, very small amber gem on the brow and jade scroll insets. Preserve unmistakably silver tier, not gold.

items.name: gold-flower-award-crown
items.designBrief: Matched family dominant rich warm GOLD with red-orange jewel tips, five open points and taller central star-flower finial, rounded jewel lower band and restrained jade accents. Similar family proportions but separately hand-painted, no numeral.

items.name: golden-queen-diadem
items.designBrief: Low wide golden royal diadem with one large upright orange-red oval jewel in the center, gently cascading open filigree curls down left/right, ivory cloud insets and small jade drops. Not a full enclosed five-point crown, no movie/QQ identity.

items.name: crystal-heart-red-bow
items.designBrief: A plump deep-red silk bow/heart knot viewed diagonally, two loops and two short full ribbon tails, central clear ice-blue four-point crystal CROSS brooch held by thin warm-gold trim. Preserve red fabric and crystal intersection, tiny jade bead, no external aura.

items.name: crane-feather-blessing-coronet
items.designBrief: An original blessing headdress ornament with a slim vertical sapphire-blue jade central pin and a shorter horizontal cloud-carved bar, broad ivory crane feather fans spread left/right behind it, two down-sweeping soft feather tips. Delicate gold binding and jade bead, no halo, no wearer or blue UI square.
